title: Fast rising star, Mish does not disappoint in the release of his recent track “Smoke”
htmlContent:
Fast-rising music star Mish is a talented poetic genius and songwriter based in America. Mish gives you everything as he hits the mark with true mastery to show us that he is a stand-out emcee to look out for. Mish does not disappoint in the release of his recent track "Smoke."

Mish's "Smoke" is a fantastic work, daring in its articulation, as he gives you authentic and unique beats and flows. Each hard line is delivered with the ultimate conviction, as he blends his high skill level with an inspirational message of taking a leap of faith that connects on the right level.
